cases.name: Shurvonn Laketa “Chizzy” Byrd
cases.narrative: On 1/12/2024, her body was found in her home. First responders received a call just before noon Thursday about a deceased woman found “covered in blood” on the floor of the suspect’s home. According to a criminal complaint, Byrd had an extension cord wrapped around her body with a couple pairs of pliers and a sword lying next to her on the ground.
